offering_description.value: Provides consulting, analytics and managed services to healthcare, higher education and commercial organizations. Sells engagements directly to executives, delivered by consultants on project contracts or long-term outsourced operations contracts.

primary_services.value: healthcare consulting; education consulting; financial and operational advisory; revenue cycle managed services; analytics and technology implementation

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals and health systems, corporations, life sciences companies, law firms; B2G: public universities and state or public agencies

end_markets.value: healthcare; higher education; life sciences; corporate and commercial

revenue_model.value: project or contract: consulting engagements billed on fees or time for advisory projects; service fees: multi-year managed services for revenue cycle and operations functions

value_chain_position.value: service provider: sells consultant time and managed operations to health systems, universities and companies

geography_served.value: global: mainly US clients, with some clients and offices in other countries

specialization.value: diversified: separate businesses for healthcare, education and commercial clients with different customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: executive relationships and direct client contracts with institutions and companies

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: healthcare privacy and billing rules such as HIPAA, plus education and government contracting rules
